answer_1.quote: A recent line of research in Natural Language Inference (NLI) focuses on developing models capable of generating natural language explanations in support of their predictions.

answer_2.quote: External feedback from TPs is effective in improving the quality of natural language explanations, leading to an increase in logical validity ... and a reduction of syntax errors of 68.67%, 62.31%, and 55.17%.

answer_4.quote: In addition to evaluating the logical validity of explanations, we also conducted a human evaluation of the refined explanations, considering factual correctness and explanation triviality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked: "Are the refined explanatory sentences factually correct?" and "Is the explanation trivial, merely repeating or paraphrasing the content of the premise and hypothesis?"
